title: Calibrated Uncertainty Quantification on TDC ADMET: What Can Be Resolved Across 22 Datasets?
abstract: arXiv:2611.09373v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models often rely on small, heterogeneous datasets, yet their predictions may determine which compounds proceed to experimental testing. Useful evaluations must therefore assess both predictive performance and the quality of reported probabilities or intervals. We ask which common uncertainty-quantification methods perform best on the 22 Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC) ADMET datasets and what this benchmark can resolve. We compare eleven calibrated pipelines using nested five-fold cross-validation across ten chemical partitions and five model seeds. Ensemble Monte Carlo (MC) dropout has the best average rank for TDC performance, Brier score, and 90% interval score. For TDC performance, however, it is not separated from the other ensemble pipelines; for Brier and interval score, LightGBM is also not ruled out as best. LightGBM wins more individual datasets than any

translated_title: TDC ADMET上的校准不确定性量化：在22个数据集上能分辨出什么？
translated_abstract: 吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）模型通常依赖小型且异构的数据集，然而其预测可能决定哪些化合物进入实验测试阶段。因此，有效的评估必须同时考察预测性能以及所报告的概率或区间的质量。我们探究了哪些常用的不确定性量化方法在22个Therapeutics Data Commons（TDC）ADMET数据集上表现最佳，以及该基准究竟能够分辨出什么。我们采用嵌套五折交叉验证，在十个化学分区和五个模型随机种子下比较了十一条经过校准的流水线。集成蒙特卡洛（MC）dropout在TDC性能、Brier分数和90%区间评分上的平均排名最佳。然而，就TDC性能而言，它与其他集成流水线并无显著区分；就Brier分数和区间评分而言，LightGBM也不能被排除为最佳。LightGBM在单个数据集上获胜的次数多于任何其他方法……
tldr: 在22个TDC ADMET数据集的基准测试中，集成蒙特卡洛dropout取得了最佳平均排名，但统计上无法将其与其他集成方法或LightGBM明确区分开，说明该基准的分辨能力有限。
en_tdlr: On 22 TDC ADMET datasets, ensemble Monte Carlo dropout achieves the best average ranks, but the benchmark cannot statistically separate it from other ensemble pipelines or LightGBM, highlighting its limited resolvability.
